title: A Generalizable Machine Learning Framework for Half-Heusler Thermoelectrics
abstract: arXiv:2602.01149v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for accelerating the discovery of thermoelectric (TE) materials, yet many models suffer from limited generalizability. Here we present a robust ML framework for predicting the thermoelectric figure of merit (zT) in half-Heusler (hH) compounds, emphasizing prediction of previously unseen compositions. A principal component analysis (PCA)-based train/test splitting strategy is introduced to generate representative partitions of chemical space. Bayesian hyperparameter optimization is combined with correlation-based k-best feature selection for Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Network models, together with the interpretable SISSO symbolic-regression method. Relative to the full set of 118 input features, the optimized feature subsets reduce the test RMSE by 16-27%. translated_title: 一种面向半哈斯勒热电材料的可泛化机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）已成为加速热电（TE）材料发现的强大方法，然而许多模型的可泛化性有限。本文提出了一个用于预测半哈斯勒（hH）化合物热电品质因数（zT）的稳健机器学习框架，重点在于对先前未见成分的预测。我们引入了一种基于主成分分析（PCA）的训练/测试集划分策略，以生成化学空间中具有代表性的分区。针对随机森林、XGBoost和神经网络模型，将贝叶斯超参数优化与基于相关性的k最优特征选择相结合，并辅以可解释的SISSO符号回归方法。相对于全部118个输入特征，优化后的特征子集将测试集均方根误差（RMSE）降低了16-27%。SHAP和SISSO分析确定温度、A位掺杂浓度和A位汽化热为关键特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可泛化的机器学习框架，通过基于PCA的数据划分策略、贝叶斯超参数优化与特征选择，能够准确预测半哈斯勒化合物（包括未见成分）的热电品质因数zT，并将RMSE降低16-27%。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a generalizable machine learning framework that combines PCA-based data splitting, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, and feature selection to accurately predict the thermoelectric figure of merit zT of half-Heusler compounds, including previously unseen compositions.
